to entice you and is home to the largest established public rose
garden in Alberta.
Make sure and visit the gift shop filled with jewelery, tableware,
home and garden décor, books and more. The garden is open
from sunrise to sunset daily. The gift shop is open 10 am to
7 pm Sunday to Friday and 10 am to 5 pm on Saturdays during
the spring and summer. Free admission and plenty of
accessible parking.

includes trails, a boardwalk, picnic area and interpretive signage
to educate visitors about wetland ecosystems, sustainable land
use, storm water treatment, native plants, waterfowl and other
wildlife that frequent the site.
